description: a 10 x 10 plate 2 thick with a hole of radius 1 through it, its axis 1.5 from the front edge y = 0; the hole's top rim filleted at r 0.8. The convex ring's contact on the top is a circle of radius 1.8 about the hole's axis, which leaves the top through the plate's front edge, not the blend's own, between x = 5 ± √(1.8² − 1.5²). The ball rolls on that edge there, as Open CASCADE rolls it for a boss's root (blend/standoff-root-fillet-runs-off-the-plate); the torus is one face open at the rolled face

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE splits the ring's torus in two, either side of the rolled patch, joined by an edge at the seam; Arris keeps the torus one face open at the rolled face, its seam inside it (ADR-0071 §2)
